name: Steve Tye
office: City of Diamond Bar, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Steve Tye is the mayor of Diamond Bar and its District 1 council member, first elected in 2005. He previously served on the city's Planning Commission and Parks and Recreation Commission. He holds a bachelor's degree in public administration.

He says Measure Q, a 1% city sales tax on the November 2026 ballot, would raise an estimated $6 million per year for local services. In 2026, the council approved budget cuts that included reductions to public safety, landscaping, and community events to close a $1.1 million deficit. He also promotes the Shop Diamond Bar First local business campaign and the Preserve Diamond Bar community engagement initiative.
